content.text:
I can help, but I can’t complete the booking myself without a reservation platform/account and your contact details.

**This Friday is June 12, 2026.** For **2 people, Friday night, downtown Chicago**, good Italian options with reservations include:

1. **Osteria Via Stato** — River North; authentic Italian; has an online reservation link. ([osteriaviastato.com](https://www.osteriaviastato.com/?utm_source=openai))  
2. **The Village / Italian Village** — Loop; long-running classic Italian spot with online “Find a Table.” ([thevillage-chicago.com](https://www.thevillage-chicago.com/?utm_source=openai))  
3. **La Bella Chicago** — Loop/Theatre District; reservation page available. ([labellachicago.com](https://www.labellachicago.com/reservations?utm_source=openai))  
4. **Monteverde** — West Loop; popular upscale Italian, often harder to book. ([monteverdechicago.com](https://monteverdechicago.com/?utm_source=openai))  
5. **Adalina** — Gold Coast; modern Italian, reservations recommended especially Friday/Saturday evenings. ([opentable.com](https://www.opentable.com/r/adalina-italian-chicago?avt=eyJ2IjoyLCJtIjoxLCJwIjoxLCJzIjowLCJuIjowfQ&corrid=9e424cd6-2c6f-4330-b92c-3f71e0d1fe90&originId=9e424cd6-2c6f-4330-b92c-3f71e0d1fe90&utm_source=openai))  

Please tell me:
- Preferred time: **6:00, 7:00, 8:00, or flexible?**
- Budget/vibe: **casual, classic, upscale, romantic?**
- Any dietary restrictions?
- Name and phone/email you want on the reservation?

Once you give me those, I can narrow it to the best option and draft the exact reservation request or guide you through booking.
